Question: The sum of the zeros, the product of the zeros, and the sum of the coefficients of the function \(f(x)=ax^2+bx+c\) are equal. Their common value must also be which of the following?

Choices.D: one of the \(x\)-intercepts of the graph of \(y=f(x)\)
Choices.E:
the mean of the \(x\)-intercepts of the graph of
\(y=f(x)\)
